chat.title: Assistant
chat.loadFailed: The assistant could not be loaded
chat.noSites: The assistant works on one of your sites. Add a site to start.
chat.noConversationHint: Start one to ask about a site or change its data.
chat.emptyConversation: Ask a question about your site. Nothing changes unless you allow it.

list.label: Conversations
list.title: Conversations
list.deleteBody: “{{title}}” and its messages are removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.

new.title: New conversation
new.body: Choose the site and the model. You can allow changes later.

mode.label: What the assistant may do
mode.readHelp: Read only: the assistant can look at your data but cannot change anything.
mode.askHelp: Ask before changes: the assistant shows you each change and waits for your answer.
mode.locked: The mode cannot change while the assistant is answering.

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Esc stops the assistant.

approval.label: Approval needed
approval.appTitle: The assistant wants to make a change

paused.title: Paused after many steps
paused.body: The assistant paused so it does not run on forever. Continue to let it go on.

onboarding.title: Set up the Assistant
onboarding.intro: Choose the model the Assistant uses. Your key stays in this computer's keychain.
onboarding.anthropicHint: Claude models. You need an API key.
onboarding.openaiHint: GPT models with your OpenAI API key.
onboarding.geminiHint: Gemini models with a Google AI Studio API key.
onboarding.detecting: Looking for a model on this computer…
onboarding.localHint: Runs on this computer. No key needed.
onboarding.noLocal: No Ollama or LM Studio found on this computer.
onboarding.customHint: Any server that speaks the OpenAI API, at an address you give.
onboarding.customUrlHint: Use https, unless the server runs on this computer.

provider.title: Assistant providers
provider.intro: Where the Assistant's models run. Keys are kept in this computer's keychain, never in the settings file.
provider.detectNone: No Ollama or LM Studio found.
provider.editBody: Change the name, address or default model.
provider.name: Name
provider.urlHint: Use https, unless the server runs on this computer.
provider.keyDialogBody: Paste the key. It is checked, then saved in the keychain.
provider.deleteBody: {{name}} and its saved key are removed from this computer. Existing conversations keep their text but cannot continue.

key.label: {{name}} API key
key.hint: Paste the key here. It is not shown again.
key.optionalHint: Optional. Only if the server asks for one.

models.failed: The models could not be listed

provider.keyCleared: The address changed, so the saved key was removed. Enter it again.
